node.statement: The scope of node 1.3 contains no definitions, assumptions, dependencies, or externals. The sole workspace external, GT-cairns-1935-theorem-p549, is only the conditional implication: if a class-one manifold is already covered by domains of finitely many allowable coordinate systems, then it can be triangulated into the cells of a finite complex; it does not assert that an arbitrary modern C^1 manifold is class-one or has an allowable atlas.
